area_note: Extremely small size-optimized core. The entire core register file is 1024 flops. A custom 16-word operand buffer (512 flops) is massive relative to this core and would increase its size by a significant fraction.
constraints: The PCPI coprocessor interface has no memory access capability.
All operands required by a custom instruction must be loaded from memory into core registers explicitly by standard load instructions before invocation.
A custom instruction can consume at most two 32-bit source registers (pcpi_rs1, pcpi_rs2) and produce at most one 32-bit result (pcpi_rd).
Given the core's minimal footprint, large internal memory buffers or excessive combinatorial logic in the coprocessor should be avoided.
coprocessor: Pico Co-Processor Interface (PCPI). Exposes ports pcpi_valid, pcpi_insn, pcpi_rs1, pcpi_rs2. The coprocessor receives the instruction and up to two register values. It DOES NOT have memory address or data ports and therefore cannot address memory by itself.
coprocessor_result: 32 bits returned per instruction via pcpi_rd, enabled by pcpi_wr, and signaling completion via pcpi_ready.
custom_opcode_space: Any opcode not natively decoded by the core will trigger instr_trap and be forwarded to the PCPI (e.g., standard custom0-3 spaces).
evidence: picorv32 module parameters (ENABLE_MUL, COMPRESSED_ISA, ENABLE_DIV) establish the ISA support.
cpu_state FSM in picorv32.v proves the multi-cycle microarchitecture.
PCPI ports (pcpi_valid, pcpi_rs1, pcpi_rs2, pcpi_rd, pcpi_wr, pcpi_wait, pcpi_ready) entirely lack memory bus signals, proving the coprocessor cannot address memory.
instr_trap logic explicitly forwards unrecognized instructions to the PCPI if WITH_PCPI is enabled.
picorv32_regs definition shows the physical layout of the register file (max 2 read ports, 1 write port).
existing_units: Barrel shifter (enabled via BARREL_SHIFTER, otherwise iterative shift)
isa: RV32I with configurable options for M (ENABLE_MUL, ENABLE_FAST_MUL, ENABLE_DIV) and C (COMPRESSED_ISA) extensions.
memory_interface: Native 32-bit valid/ready multi-cycle handshake (mem_valid, mem_ready, mem_addr, mem_wdata, mem_wstrb, mem_rdata). Optional AXI4-Lite adapter (picorv32_axi_adapter) provided.
microarchitecture: Multi-cycle FSM. Core transitions through cpu_state_fetch, cpu_state_ld_rs1, cpu_state_ld_rs2, cpu_state_exec, cpu_state_ldmem, cpu_state_stmem. Assuming single-cycle memory, ALU ops take ~3-4 cycles and loads ~5-6 cycles.
name: PicoRV32
register_file: 16 or 32 32-bit registers (ENABLE_REGS_16_31). Has 2 read ports and 1 write port when ENABLE_REGS_DUALPORT is true, otherwise 1 read port.
